title: Iterative Prompting with Persuasion Skills in Jailbreaking Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on an adversarial attack methodology (iterative prompting and persuasion) to bypass safety guardrails in LLMs. While the attack success is measured against prompts involving ethical violations (like hate speech or violence), the study is centered on security, robustness, and attack techniques rather than benchmarking or evaluating religion, moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks themselves.
